name: Line draw-on
one_line: A stroke draws itself along its path: connectors, underlines, signatures, route lines
summary: A line appears by travelling along its own path, so the eye follows the stroke as it grows. It joins things, underlines a word, signs off or traces a route, and shows direction and order without a label. A path drawn too slowly stalls the beat, and one drawn at constant speed with no easing can feel mechanical.

routes.one_line: Reveal an inline SVG path with Anime.js on a seeked timeline

steps.does: Reveal the path's stroke along its length on one timeline
Seek, settle and screenshot each frame of the page

limits: The fixture draws one curve; joined connectors and several paths drawn in turn are untested
Anime.js evidence excludes morphing, so a stroke that changes shape while drawing is outside it

routes.one_line: Animate the stroke offset of an SVG path with the Web Animations API, seeked per frame

steps.does: Animate the path's stroke offset from hidden to fully drawn
Seek, settle and screenshot each frame of the page

limits: The fixture draws one curve with linear timing; eased and sequenced draws are untested
Motion paths and path morphs are outside the tool's guidance

routes.one_line: Redraw a path on a 2D canvas, stroking only the part reached at t

steps.does: Stroke the portion of the path reached at t, redrawn each seek

limits: Evidence covers an arc and a gradient, not a path drawn progressively
Evidence is at device pixel ratio 1; thin strokes at higher ratios are untested
